SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: the public anon JWT printed by deploy/selfhost/install.sh (not the sb_publishable_ key: the self-hosted Realtime needs the JWT)
DEMO_EMAIL: email of the demo account (created by tool/create_demo_user.py)
DEMO_PASSWORD: its password: shipped inside the app, so use a throw-away one
ADMIN_DEMO_EMAIL: OPTIONAL: a staff account for the admin page's demo button. Leave it out in the build a customer can open (see docs/decisions.md)
